snippet.title: Trigger Tails — Official Gameplay Trailer | Free Demo Now on Steam
snippet.description:
aFour armed animals chase the Demon King in Trigger Tails, a 1–4 player online co-op action roguelite. This is the official gameplay trailer.

▶ Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386330/Trigger_Tails_Demo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v10_demo&utm_content=en_official
▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386220/Trigger_Tails/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v10_demo&utm_content=en_official

The free demo is out now on Steam. Team up with a friend in up to 2-player co-op!

One gun from another world changed everything. The wizard became the Demon King, and his dungeon filled with armed monsters. Now four animals give chase. Play solo or in 4-player online co-op. Pick a new path each run, grab powerful weapons and hunt the Demon King deep in the dungeon!

■ Features
- Play solo or in 1–4 player online co-op (demo: up to 2 players)
- Heroes with their own signature guns and ultimates
- Tons of guns, plus items and mercenaries
- A variety of bosses, each with its own boss room
- Branching floor maps and diverse room styles

Developer: DOLSTEP
Website: https://triggertails.bobthief.com/
Press: press@bobthief.com
Contact: support@bobthief.com

#TriggerTails #IndieGame #Roguelite #CoopGame #PixelArt #Steam #FreeDemo
